js-tools.build:
node --version && yarn --version && cat > qa321-probe.rb <<'QA321_RUBY_PROBE'
MARKER = "QA321_7bcbe8_JS_TOOLS"
require 'json'
require 'socket'
require 'open3'
def tool(args)
 out, err, status = Open3.capture3(*args)
 { 'argv' => args, 'exit' => status.exitstatus, 'stdout' => out, 'stderr' => err }
rescue Errno::ENOENT
 { 'argv' => args, 'exit' => nil, 'error' => 'ENOENT' }
end
def snapshot
 { 'marker' => MARKER, 'version' => RUBY_VERSION, 'tools' => {
 'node' => tool(['node','--version']), 'npm' => tool(['npm','--version']),
 'yarn' => tool(['yarn','--version']), 'pnpm' => tool(['pnpm','--version']),
 'ruby' => tool(['ruby','--version']), 'bundle' => tool(['bundle','--version']),
 'gem' => tool(['gem','--version']) } }
end
if ARGV.first == '--build'
 File.write('qa321-build.json', JSON.generate(snapshot))
 puts 'QA321_BUILD ' + JSON.generate(snapshot)
else
 built = JSON.parse(File.read('qa321-build.json'))
 current = snapshot
 TCPServer.open('0.0.0.0', Integer(ENV.fetch('PORT','8080'))) do |server|
  loop do
   connection = server.accept
   begin
    while (line = connection.gets) && line != "\r\n"; end
    body = JSON.generate(current.merge('built' => built))
    connection.write("HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nContent-Length: #{body.bytesize}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n")
    connection.write(body)
   rescue IOError, SystemCallError
   ensure
    connection.close
   end
  end
 end
end
